newsitem.title: USA: Tenneco says not in Australian negotiations.
newsitem.headline: Tenneco says not in Australian negotiations.

text.p: Tenneco Inc is not negotiating the sale of its Australian assets, spokesman Art House said.
The talks are "between El Paso Energy Corp and other parties ... possibly including Australian Gas Light (Co)," he said.

House was responding to Australian Gas Light managing director Len Bleasel's statement to reporters that Australia Gas Light may not be able to reach an agreement with Tenneco over the sale of its Australian assets.
House also pointed out that any sale is contingent on the announced merger of Tenneco Energy with El Paso Energy.
The merger is part of Tenneco's restructuring, which will be voted on by shareholders on December 10.
